We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (three outcomes). We need to choose one that can be further processed with next template 1914389, then 1914390, then 149040, then 1914391.

We have applied 1914389 to some candidates and got results. Need to chain correctly.

Let's examine the first application of 29646 result: It returned three possible outcomes (tuples). The result string: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO',))"

So three possible disconnections: (1) product with silyl protecting group on the side chain? Actually first has CO[Si] group attached to side chain? second is same but without silyl? third has silyl on the OH.

We need to apply template 1914389 next. We tried applying to some of these. The successful one was applying to "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO" gave two precursors: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO" and "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". That seems plausible.

Now we need to apply 1914390 to the first precursor (the one with silyl still? Actually the first is "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO". We applied 1914390 to that and got "CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1". That's a product with silyl still.

Now we need to apply template 149040 next. Let's apply 149040 to that product.
